criteria.statement: External MCP servers are disabled by default and enabled servers require explicit permission rules.
The generic client implements initialize, tools/list, and tools/call over JSON-RPC HTTP with auth headers and timeouts.
External tool names are prefixed and collisions are rejected before discovery.
External tools merge into assistant discovery and calls remain subject to the existing permission engine.
agentmemory keeps typed helper methods while using the generic MCP tools/call client internally.
